reserves.name: OUSG tokenized Treasury fund portfolio
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ondo I LP OUSG portfolio: State Street Galaxy SWEEP, BlackRock BUIDL, Franklin Templeton BENJI, Fidelity FYOXX, Silicon Valley Bank deposits, and USDC (per issuer portfolio table dated 2026-07-13)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
reserveReview.rationale: The live Chainlink NAV adapter captures OUSG as a single portfolio-NAV row, so the prior seven-position static envelope could never classify the runtime exposure and its BUIDL-only label was stale. The issuer's portfolio table dated July 13, 2026 reports seven positions totaling $408,120,484: State Street Galaxy SWEEP 36.80%, BlackRock BUIDL 24.76%, Franklin BENJI 18.89%, Fidelity FYOXX 18.28%, Silicon Valley Bank deposits 1.00%, USDC at Coinbase 0.23%, and funds-in-transit/net receivables 0.03%. The static envelope is restated on the live row identity with that position-level detail preserved here, and the adapter assetLabel and assetRisk were corrected to describe the diversified fund portfolio rather than BUIDL alone.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live chainlink-nav adapter row identity; issuer-published OUSG position table dated 2026-07-13 for constituent detail
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer publishes the full position-level portfolio, but the runtime reserve row is a single NAV identity that aggregates all positions; BUIDL and BENJI are tracked assets that the runtime row cannot split out.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The live Chainlink NAV adapter collapses the diversified OUSG portfolio into one NAV row; the issuer's 2026-07-13 position table documents the constituents (SWEEP 36.8%, BUIDL 24.8%, BENJI 18.9%, FYOXX 18.3%, SVB deposits 1.0%, USDC 0.2%) but the runtime row cannot carry per-position links.

providers.name: Underlying fund custodians, Coinbase, and Silicon Valley Bank

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo identifies current portfolio positions and the fund administrator, but the reviewed materials do not establish account-level segregation, bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms for every underlying provider.
